translations.english: Arrows having lion and tiger face, buzzards and red geese face, eagles and falcons faced, in the same way arrows with jackals' face, wolves' face, terrible with mouth wide open five headed serpent like fearful sharp arrows were released by Ravana.
translations.hindi: शुणसम्प्न --माल्यालडकतम्‌ | ( गोऽ )२ विमलाम्बरवर्चसम्‌-- त्रिणबतितसः सगः १०१६ उसे झपट कर जाते देख, राक्षसा ने सिंहनाद किआ | फिर रावण को क्रद्ध देख, वे प*्स्पर एक दसरे को गले लगा कहने लगे
